basic_details.job_title: District Collectorate Theni Assistant Receptionist Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The District Collector, Thiru. V. Sivakrishnamurthy, I.A.S., has released a recruitment notification through the District Differently Abled Welfare Office, Theni, for the post of Assistant Receptionist (Backward Classes (Muslim) / Minorities). Eligible candidates can submit their filled applications to the District Differently Abled Welfare Office located within the District Collectorate campus, Theni, by 5:00 PM on 13 November 2026.

qualification.details: Educational Qualification: 8th standard pass. Disability Requirement: 100% visually impaired. Age Limit: Up to 40 years. Experience: One year of experience in cane chair weaving (நாற்காலி வயர் பின்னுவதில்). Candidates who have registered their employment in the office with this experience will be given preference.

important_instructions: Applications must reach the District Differently Abled Welfare Office within the District Collectorate campus by 5:00 PM on 13.11.2026.

content_sections.heading: About District Collectorate Theni Assistant Receptionist
content_sections.text: This recruitment is conducted by the District Differently Abled Welfare Office located within the District Collectorate campus in Theni, under the administrative control of the District Collector, Thiru. V. Sivakrishnamurthy, I.A.S. The opening aims to fill a vacancy for the Assistant Receptionist post specifically designated for Backward Classes (Muslim) candidates.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted to the District Differently Abled Welfare Office situated within the District Collectorate campus, Theni. content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Educational Qualification: 8th standard pass. Disability Requirement: 100% visually impaired. Age Limit: Up to 40 years. Experience: One year of experience in cane chair weaving (நாற்காலி வயர் பின்னுவதில்). Candidates who have registered their employment in the office with this experience will be given preference.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Proof of employment office registration reflecting cane chair weaving experience (if employment was registered in the office) Proof of Backward Classes (Muslim) / Minorities category Unique Disability ID (UDID) Card Aadhaar card Family ration card 2 photographs

faq.question: Q1. What post is being recruited through notice Se.Ve.En.64?
faq.answer: The notice recruits for the post of Assistant Receptionist for Backward Classes (Muslim) / Minorities.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Assistant Receptionist post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application is 13 November 2026 up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational and visual qualification requirements?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the 8th standard and must be 100% visually impaired.

faq.question: Q5. Is prior experience required for this post?
faq.answer: Applicants with one year of experience in cane chair weaving, and whose employment has been registered in the office with this registration, will be given preference.

faq.question: Q6. What documents must be enclosed with the application?
faq.answer: Applicants must attach employment office registration proof (if registered), Backward Classes (Muslim) category proof, UDID card, Aadhaar card, family ration card, and 2 photographs.

faq.question: Q7. Where should the completed application be submitted?
faq.answer: The application must be submitted to the District Differently Abled Welfare Office situated within the District Collectorate campus, Theni.
